sentence: The note should report dated Brent spot (126.55, FRED, 2026-10-14) above the front-month future (105.92, BZ=F, 2026-10-15) as the physical premium Bernardo has said persists through 2026 because of the Iran war and Hormuz risk, not as a data error, noting the different dates and flagging only a sharp change in the gap.
